command: Correct gallate preparation evidence, source-scoped GalB cytosol annotation and GO reference navigation

Applied supported fixes after immutable scientific and technical initial reviews. Exact preparation citations now support the native 022/026/037 enzyme contexts and DesB qualifiers; table measurements are no longer used as host assignments. Added source-scoped computational GalB monomer cytosol evidence (GO:0005829, EV-COMP-AINF/PSORTdb) and retained an append-only correction to the historical false-absence ledger. Replaced the unavailable GO release navigation URL with the verified official GO:0046943 term page, distinguishing current navigation from pinned semantic SQL provenance. The 129 existing triples and edge/qualifier descriptions remain unchanged; the corrected record has 130 edges and 78 participants. Authority files are unchanged. Exact application and predecessor bindings are retained under research/pathway_additions/2026-10-14-next-259/corrections/application. Independent successor review, rendering and final repository gates remain pending.
